Name: Flowerz
Description: A puzzle game of planting coloured flowers so that matching runs of them bloom and clear.

Achievements.Name: Master Florist
Achievements.Description: Score 9,000 points during a single Standard game.

Achievements.Name: Clean Slate
Achievements.Description: Clear the board of flowers in Standard and Expert modes.

Achievements.Name: Green Thumb
Achievements.Description: Reach level 20 in a single game of Standard or Expert mode.

Achievements.Name: Flowerz Zen
Achievements.Description: Earn 250,000 total points in games of Flowerz.

Achievements.Name: Butterfly Luck
Achievements.Description: Use 100 total butterflies in games of Flowerz.

Achievements.Name: Plan Far Ahead
Achievements.Description: Clear 12 flowers with a single flower placement.

Achievements.Name: Petal Power
Achievements.Description: Match 5 flowers in a single row.

Achievements.Name: Window Garden
Achievements.Description: Earn 100,000 total points in games of Flowerz.

Achievements.Name: Florist
Achievements.Description: Clear 1,000 total flowers in games of Flowerz.

Achievements.Name: Plan Ahead
Achievements.Description: Create a 3 level cascade of flowers.

Achievements.Name: Rotating Crops
Achievements.Description: Play a single game of Standard and Expert modes.

Achievements.Name: Bouquet
Achievements.Description: Create 100 total flower matches in games of Flowerz.

Achievements.Name: First Bloom
Achievements.Description: Complete the first level in a game of Flowerz.
